verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention-policy or data-deletion controls, such as configurable log or data retention windows, account or project data purge, or deletion guarantees. Backup retention tiers are fixed by plan rather than user-controlled. Self-hosting's general "full control over your data", Cron jobs that could run SQL deletes, and CLI telemetry opt-out are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit for this story.
